reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and every provider uses prepareBankAccountLink, but replacement repeats existing unlink state changes.

duplication.why: The change duplicates the linked-account lookup, the local unlink update, and the transaction download request/error/response sequence.

placement.why: Provider integration follows existing module boundaries, although link preparation policy is split between app.ts and link.ts.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option, and Fintegra server integration.

maintainability.why: Shared preparation and linking make provider integration straightforward, but parallel ownership queries and unlink updates create multiple maintenance points for the same rules.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts: replaceExistingAccountLink independently implements the local state reset owned by app.ts: unlinkAccount; that reset should be extracted so replacement can share it without invoking provider removal.

disguised_duplication.where: link.ts reshapes the same ownership SQL across ensureAccountIsNotLinked and replaceExistingAccountLink; sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions condenses the existing authenticated transaction download and response mapping sequence.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink introduces the replaceExistingLink parameter and replacement branch; replaceExistingAccountLink bypasses the existing unlink action's local reset by reproducing it.
